#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long mod = 998244353LL;

long long exp(long long a, long long n) {
    long long res = 1LL;
    while (n > 0) {
        if (n & 1) {
            res = (res * a) % mod;
        }
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    if ((n * m & 1) == 1) {
        cout << exp(r - l + 1, n * m) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    long long E = r / 2 - (l - 1) / 2;
    long long O = (r - l + 1) - E;

    long long ans = (exp(E + O, n * m) + exp(E - O, n * m)) % mod;
    ans = (ans * exp(2, mod - 2)) % mod;

    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
